requirements.text: Testing Decisions separates accepted mandatory checks, optional evaluations and proposed seams. A proposed test does not become mandatory through synthesis or seam approval alone.
Behavioral skill evaluations are optional unless explicitly required by the user. Missing optional runtime does not block spec publication. Unperformed evaluations remain not-run.

Explicitly mandatory evaluations retain their requirement; record verified runner, invocation, access, judge, capture and initial paid budget or name unresolved prerequisites without claiming executable readiness.
Synthesize available requirements without routine seam confirmation or inventing testing decisions.
